learning_outcomes.text: To compare advanced technology ceramics and conventional ceramics
To distinguish the features of advanced ceramics and to compare function and applications of those materials with each other.
To categorize ceramic raw materials, and to debate their features and processing methods

syllabus_topics: Introduction, Ceramic Industry, current status of ceramic industries, classification of ceramic, traditional and new (fine) engineering ceramics
Ceramic raw materials and their processing
Rare earths materials, their features and production
Principles of ceramic powder production (sol-gel), solution, CVD (chemical vapor deposition), PVD (physical vapor deposition).
Ceramic powders processing and characterization of ceramic powders their properties (as an example: Production of alumina powder)
Powder consolidation techniques of ceramic products, densification
Drying and firing of ceramic, sintering
Introduction to composites and its applications, comparison them with the other industrial materials
Composites systems, classification, fabrications composite reinforcements and mechanical and thermal properties composites.
